contributions.detail: REPORT 2 (Ladd Kennington) CLOSES EXACTLY: the single row 2,000 equals the p7 page subtotal, the p7 Total Contributions Received, and Summary boxes B, C and F, all 2,000. REPORT 1 (Chris Booth) DOES NOT: the seven Schedule A rows read 1000.00 + 200.00 + 100.00 + 100.00 + 100.00 + 220.00 + 200.00 = 1920.00, while the printed 'Subtotal for this page' AND 'Total Contributions Received' both read 1830.00, and Summary boxes B, C and F all read 1830.00 - a consistent filer figure 90.00 BELOW the itemization. Every one of the seven amounts was re-read in a 600dpi amount-column crop and none is bistable; no row is 90.00 and no pair differs by 90.00, so no single mis-read produces the printed figure. The delta is the FILER's arithmetic; both figures retained verbatim, rows published as written with needs_review:1 on every contributions row of report 1. Scope: Box B (this period) and Box C (year-to-date) are EQUAL in both reports - single report of the cycle - so the two scopes coincide; recorded cumulative. The CFD form has no separate '$50.00 or less' line, so the le50 anchors are null (the field does not exist), not zero.

expenditures.detail: REPORT 1 (Chris Booth) CLOSES EXACTLY ON EVERY GATE: p3's fifteen rows sum to 1472.48 = the printed p3 'Subtotal for this page'; p4's four rows sum to 378.51 = p4's printed subtotal; 1472.48 + 378.51 = 1850.99 = p4's printed 'Total Expenditures Made' AND Summary boxes D and E. (p3's Total Expenditures line is left blank by design - the form asks for it only on the last Schedule B page.) REPORT 2 (Ladd Kennington) DOES NOT: the four Schedule B rows read 600.00 + 600.00 + 400.00 + 200.00 = 1800.00, while the p8 page subtotal AND Total Expenditures Made both read 2,000, and Summary box D reads $2,000 - a filer figure 200.00 ABOVE the itemization. All four amounts were re-read at 600dpi; the third ('$400.00') is unambiguous. Delta is the filer's; rows published verbatim with needs_review:1 on every expenditure row of report 2. Scope cumulative in both reports (this-period and year-to-date cells coincide). NOTE a second internal filer inconsistency in report 2: Summary Box D reads $2,000 but Box E (year-to-date) reads $2,200 - both retained verbatim above.

gates.page_subtotal: REPORT 1: p2 rows 1920.00 vs printed subtotal 1830.00 -> WOULD NOT GATE (filer delta, 90.00). p3 rows 1472.48 = printed subtotal 1472.48 EXACT. p4 rows 378.51 = printed subtotal 378.51 EXACT; p3+p4 = 1850.99 = printed Total Expenditures Made EXACT. REPORT 2: p7 row 2,000 = printed subtotal 2,000 = printed Total EXACT. p8 rows 1800.00 vs printed subtotal 2,000 -> WOULD NOT GATE (filer delta, 200.00). The p3 gate is what settled row 8 (Sam's Club): the contact sheet and a 600dpi read both gave 132.84, which made the page sum 1472.68; a 1200dpi cell crop reads 132.64 and the page then closes on 1472.48 exactly - arithmetic and glyph agree at the higher resolution.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py returns geometry_status 'ok' with 16 h-rules (= 15 writing bands) on every schedule page of this PDF, so the CFD grid holds 15 rows per page. Inked rows counted against the grid: p2 = 7 (bands 1-7), p3 = 15 (grid FULL, which is why Schedule B continues on p4), p4 = 4, p7 = 1, p8 = 4. Rows emitted match exactly: 7 + 1 contributions, 19 + 4 expenditures.
gates.geometry_proof: REPORT 1 contributions: p2 first-row amount band renders '$1000.00', last-row (row 7) band renders '200.00', control one row-pitch below row 7 renders EMPTY. REPORT 1 expenditures: p3 first-row band renders '$856.42'; p4 first-row band renders '$8.56' and last-row (p4 row 4) band renders '50.00'; control one pitch below renders EMPTY (bare rule). REPORT 2: p7 row-1 band renders the row's own '$2...' and the control one pitch below renders EMPTY; p8 row-1 band renders that row's '$6..' and row-4 band renders '$200..', control below EMPTY. Bands are the amount cell and are accurate to about half a row height (the p4/p8 proofs clipped the glyph tops), so the emitted pct boxes sit a touch high on those two pages - stated rather than silently adjusted.
gates.balance_chain: REPORT 1 DOES NOT CLOSE and the defect is the filer's: Box A is left BLANK, B = C = 1830.00, D = E = 1850.99, F (A+B) = 1830.00, and 'Balance at Close (F - D)' is written as the zero glyph - but F - D = -20.99. Using the ITEMIZED contributions instead (1920.00) gives 69.01, also not zero, so no reading of the schedules makes the filer's zero correct. REPORT 2 also does not close cleanly: Box A carries a figure ('$2,000') that the filer then STRUCK THROUGH, B = C = 2,000, D = 2,000 but E = 2,200, F = 2,000, Balance at Close written '- 0 -'; F - D = 0 holds only if D is 2,000, which contradicts E. Both filings are single reports of their cycle, so there is no prior filing to chain a LAST->CUM test against; the two reports in this PDF are by DIFFERENT filers and must not be chained to each other.

notes: THIS PDF STAPLES TWO REPORTS BY TWO DIFFERENT CANDIDATES and the chunk file's candidate column merges them into one string, 'Chris Booth Ladd Kennington'. Transcribed as report_no 1 = CHRIS BOOTH (pages 1-5) and report_no 2 = LADD KENNINGTON (pages 6-9); n_reports_in_pdf = 2. Both office lines are IN SCOPE county offices read from inside the form: Booth's cover Office box reads 'COUNTY COUNCIL NORTHEAST', Kennington's reads 'County Council' - both agree with the chunk file's 'County Council'. Booth's cover marks TWO report-type boxes ('30 Days after withdrawal or elimination' AND '30 Days after the Primary Election') and answers 'No' to the amendment question; Date of Report 7/26/22. Kennington's cover marks '30 Days after elimination', leaves the amendment question UNANSWERED (neither Yes nor No filled), Date of Report 7-27-22. The footer block (Name of Candidate / Date of Report / Page) is present on every schedule page and was used to confirm page-to-report assignment: Booth pages numbered 1,2,3,4,5 and Kennington pages 1,2,3,4 - i.e. each report numbers its own pages, so the PDF page number and the printed page number differ. THIS FORM VARIANT'S COVER PAGE CARRIES NO LETTERED BOXES - the A-F Summary is a SEPARATE page at the end of each report (p5 and p9); the box anchors above are read from there. The form prints no '$50.00 or less' aggregate line at all, so those anchors are null. Addresses are printed in the clear on Schedule A; street lines, PO boxes and ZIPs were discarded at read time and only city/state emitted. Booth's own phone and personal email appear on his cover and are likewise discarded. Two Schedule A cells hold no city: Kennington's self-contribution address cell gives street + ZIP only, so donor_city/donor_state are left BLANK rather than inferred from the cover or the ZIP; and Booth's row 6 address cell holds a descriptive note, not an address.
